answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Employment verification via payroll hash. It demands a payroll record an employer attests to, and the grove is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. What makes this stick is that a payroll record an employer attests to cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the willow of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Time is the tax here: a payroll record an employer attests to cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the ivory for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
